gate.liveness: H-only patch-effect DiD at gripper_corridor significant under sign-flip max-T AND H0' null donor median recovery < control_threshold

interpretation_scope: Latent-forecast endpoint on the egg+gripper region; contact/clearance and fresh candidate-ranking endpoints require a readout fitted on discovery data and are not evaluated here. Checkpoint jepa_wm_droid is DROID-only (vendored training config droid_4fpcs_fps4_r256_dv3vitl_asp1_pred_AdaLN_depth12_noprop_repro_2roll_4n.yaml: datasets: [DROID], override_datasets: true); the RoboCasa contact stimuli are zero-shot for this model. H0' null-factor cells exist for 7/12 scenes: the null donor control and liveness use that subset.

selection.rule: earliest interaction-live site with >=threshold recovery in both hazard directions; band = maximal contiguous run of live sites containing it
